snippet.title: Aetheris Core - Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Aetheris Core is a fast-paced sci-fi action roguelite where you build powerful synergies, survive escalating waves, and battle massive bosses.

Wishlist and try the demo on Steam:
https://kavik.dev/aetheris

Discord community: 
https://kavik.dev/discord

Developed by Kavik Studios.

#AetherisCore #IndieGame #Steam #Roguelite #BulletHeaven
